guard: guided setup derives its connector membership from the live registry and installed manifest, and derives readiness and setup hints from connector declarations rather than connector names
command: rm -rf implementations/cli/dist && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/setup-connectors.smoke.ts
why: The old picker admitted only the literal names claude and opencode. A test covering only those names would certify the bug, so the fixtures register connector names the CLI has never heard of and pin the candidate count to a literal four.
The mutations independently restore name-based membership at the surface, name-based membership at the candidate list, and name-based setup hints. Each must redden its own genericity assertion.

mutations.name: restore the literal claude and opencode membership list
mutations.find:
const names = new Set(registry.all<Connector>("connector").map((connector) => connector.name));
  for (const name of manifestExtensionNames("connector")) names.add(name);
mutations.replace:
const declared = new Set([...registry.all<Connector>("connector").map((connector) => connector.name), ...manifestExtensionNames("connector")]);
  const names = new Set(["claude", "opencode"].filter((name) => declared.has(name)));
mutations.expectRed: registry-registered connectors join the derived setup membership
mutations.cell: registry-registered connectors join the derived setup membership
mutations.command: rm -rf implementations/cli/dist && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/setup-connectors.smoke.ts
mutations.note: The load-bearing revert for #1036: membership goes back to the hardcoded pair while every other seam stays generic. Compile-clean; both derivation reads stay live.

mutations.name: restore the claude and opencode membership gate
mutations.expectRed: every registered connector appears in setup candidates
mutations.cell: every registered connector appears in setup candidates
mutations.command: rm -rf implementations/cli/dist && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/setup-connectors.smoke.ts

mutations.name: restore the claude name check for setup hints
mutations.find:
: connector.setup
            ? connector.pluginRoot
              ? "installs a plugin"
              : "runs its own setup"
            : "ready at spawn",
mutations.replace:
: connector.setup
            ? connector.name === "claude"
              ? "installs a plugin"
              : "runs its own setup"
            : "ready at spawn",
mutations.expectRed: a non-claude connector with pluginRoot gets the plugin hint
mutations.cell: a non-claude connector with pluginRoot gets the plugin hint
mutations.command: rm -rf implementations/cli/dist && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/setup-connectors.smoke.ts
